recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: silicon halos shimmering in hardware headlines
faces kept off the feed, identity held close
diplomats exhaling after a first round at the table
an outsider claiming victory before dawn

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Stitch stutter-house beat fragments into a loop by tapping on the downbeat before the waveform collapses — each round is a tiny DJ booth in gray summer fog.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: a clean 30-second round exports a unique 4-bar loop you can instantly replay
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: BPM climbs, missed beats inject glitch artifacts that crowd the lane
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon waveform pulses bleeding through overcast marine-layer gray

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Draw a single continuous path for inspectors through a maze of sealed doors — only open the correct checkpoints before patrols reverse your progress.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: clearing every checkpoint in one unbroken gesture feels like a flawless inspection run
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: more doors spawn, patrol speed doubles, fog seals corridors behind your trail
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: paper-cutout blueprint corridors with wax-seal door icons

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Hold to charge a kite loft above Karl the Fog, release at peak to thread golden thermals between drifting cloud banks and multiplying power lines.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one perfect release sails the kite through a sunlit gap in the gray ceiling
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: gusts widen, cables tangle the sky, fog banks accelerate across the screen
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: watercolor golden gate silhouettes dissolving into summer overcast

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Swipe to peel iridescent identity halos off passing silhouettes — collect enough rings to power a privacy shield without exposing the face beneath.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: each silhouette stripped clean in under three seconds feels like a surgical extraction
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: decoy halos multiply, walkers speed up, scanning beams sweep the lane
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: iridescent silicon rings floating on matte black glass
